title: On Dataset Transferability in Active Learning for Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated by measuring the transferability of datasets actively acquired by one model to a different consumer model, using F1 score differences (ΔAUC) and comparing the performance against randomly sampled datasets.

Measured by calculating the Acquisition Sequence Mismatch (ASM) and Acquired Dataset Mismatch (ADM) to quantify how different pre-trained language models diverge in their data sampling sequences due to their distinct inductive biases.
